sections.markdown:
## D — Accuracy notes and source flags: points, suspensions and insurance requirements
Every C and C2 fact cites exactly one physical manual page from the selected range; nothing relies on outside knowledge.
The point list on the points page gives examples only and sends readers to IN.gov/BMV for the complete table, so C never claims the list is complete [A01] (verify IN-POINTS-D-TABLE).
The under-21 safety course trigger on the points page gives no time window, unlike the adult twelve-month window; C2 keeps the wording as printed [A01].
Two reinstatement fee schedules are printed, one for suspensions before and one for suspensions after the start of the fee change, and both are kept with their era [A03].
The habitual violator pages name Indiana Code sections and older pre-reform thresholds; only the current tiers and the worked example are taught, and statute citations are not turned into learner facts [A05].
Fees, the record price, State Form numbers and the BMV phone line are service details that can change and are isolated as dynamic.

corpus_stability.reason: The Indiana Driver's Manual back cover reads Published July 2026 and tells readers to check IN.gov/BMV for updates; the BMV manual page says printed manuals are updated at most once a year, so the selected pages are treated as stable within a year while fees and service details stay dynamic.

verification_debt.claim_text: Physical page 26 lists example point values and directs readers to download the complete point value table at IN.gov/BMV; any point value not on that page needs the official table before it is taught.
